nodes.name: Finalize Response
nodes.notes: Creates the only item shape allowed to enter the final Respond node: status_code plus public_response.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: Architecture V2 uses this single Respond to Webhook node for every public outcome.

nodes.name: Execute Model Router V1
nodes.notes: After import, select Model Router V1. This node waits for one normalized result per input item.

parameters.content:
## Architecture V2 — Phase 5C

Both normalized text and image-extracted text pass through Entity Intelligence Lookup V1 before Model Router V1. Lookup failure stops analysis with safe HTTP 503.

Validated LLM output is merged with authoritative backend-only database indicators after strict validation and before deterministic scoring 1.1.0. The public response shape is unchanged and internal database details are not exposed.

After import, select Entity Intelligence Lookup V1, Model Router V1, and Image Preprocessor V1 in their Execute Workflow nodes.

nodes.name: Execute Image Preprocessor V1
nodes.notes: After import, select Image Preprocessor V1. The validated Base64 image is sent only to this sub-workflow.

nodes.name: Normalize Extracted Text
nodes.notes: Converts extracted text into the existing analysis context and omits Base64 before Model Router V1.

nodes.name: Build Semantic Lookup Input
nodes.notes: Builds a fresh allowlisted semantic lookup envelope. Image Base64 and unrelated internal data are never included.

nodes.name: Execute Semantic Pattern Lookup V1
nodes.notes: After import, select Semantic Pattern Lookup V1. Semantic failure is normalized as unavailable and does not fail public analysis.

nodes.name: Attach Semantic Pattern Intelligence
nodes.notes: Attaches validated similarity intelligence for internal corroboration only. It does not create indicators or change scoring.

parameters.content:
## Architecture V2 Phase 5D-E
Semantic Pattern Intelligence is optional supporting evidence only. Entity Intelligence remains authoritative, validated LLM indicators remain evidence-grounded, and deterministic scoring remains the sole risk-score authority. Semantic similarity is not scam probability.

nodes.name: Evaluate Semantic Corroboration
nodes.notes: Deterministically checks whether already validated indicators support each retrieved semantic pattern. It never creates indicators, changes scoring, or treats similarity as scam probability.

nodes.name: Prepare Audio Input
nodes.notes: Phase 6A validates and prepares transient audio only. Base64 is kept outside context.content and never reaches analysis or intelligence workflows.

nodes.name: Build Speech-to-Text Input
nodes.notes: Creates a fresh allowlisted Speech-to-Text input. Metadata and all analysis/intelligence state are excluded.

nodes.name: Execute Speech-to-Text Provider V1
nodes.notes: After import, select Speech-to-Text Provider V1. Credentials remain inside the provider sub-workflow.

nodes.name: Validate STT Result
nodes.notes: Strictly validates the adapter result and correlates request_id and analysis_id with the prepared audio context.

nodes.name: Normalize Audio Transcript
nodes.notes: Creates transcript-only canonical analysis context and drops audio/provider data before intelligence and model routing.

parameters.content:
## Phase 6C — Audio transcription integration
Validated audio is sent only to Speech-to-Text Provider V1. The normalized transcript becomes canonical context.content and joins the existing intelligence, model validation, corroboration, and deterministic scoring path. Base64 is dropped before the canonical pipeline.
